Strategy: Mid-strong scaled awkward-band avoidance. Exact fits score highest; residuals between a third of the item and the full item lose a penalty of one and a half item sizes, while tighter and roomier residuals rank like Best Fit. The choice differs from Best Fit when the tightest fit falls in that awkward band while a looser bin can hold another item. It may help by deterring awkward leftovers, but may fail if it overuses roomy bins.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [1000.0 if r - item == 0 else (-(r - item) - 3 * item / 2 if r - item > item / 3 and r - item <= item else -(r - item)) for r in bins]
```
generator_note: Mid-strong scaled awkward-band avoidance: penalize residual in (item/3, item] by 3*item/2, exact fit highest.
